title: Arc Search Android screenshot preview measurements
caveat: Coordinates were manually read from rendered web previews, not original image binaries. Preview canvas sizes do not establish source-native pixels or display density. Bounding boxes are approximate (typically ±4–8 preview px). Do not convert directly to dp or use visual color estimates as exact RGB samples. Marketing composition entries use a larger 506x900 preview where available; these bounds are relative to that promo canvas and never assert native app dp. Five modern Lazyweb screenshots are recorded as iOS-only exclusions.
